chunks: Should I take other gods apart from Him, who would neither be able to intercede for me nor save me if Ar-Rahman brings me harm?
ai.seo_question: What is the role of intercession on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In this verse, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) reflects on the futility of idolatry, asserting that divine decree (mashi'ah) supersedes all intercession. Shia exegetes, such as Al--Ayyashi and Al-Qummi, often interpret this as a demonstration of the Prophet's deep conviction in Tawhid, where even the most powerful created beings cannot avert God's will, reinforcing the concept of absolute divine sovereignty over both benefit and harm.
